title: J.D. LaRock:
headline: Businesses are at the centre of every community. So why don't schools teach entrepreneurship?
story: Alison asked for J.D.'s answer to one question by name: what's a question in education you're still wrestling with? His answer: every community and every economy has businesses at its centre, yet schools leave entrepreneurship out. The same goes for financial literacy.
He calls it quizzical, paradoxical, frustrating, and ends with "Why this is is utterly mystifying to me." Clear, confident, national. A big question NFTE answers every day.
